source.title: underwater ambience.wav
source.author: AlienXXX
source.prepare: ffmpeg -i <file> -af "asetrate=44100*0.85,aresample=44100:resampler=soxr" alien_ocean.wav (slowed to 0.85x, pitch with it), then python scripts/sound-clean.py alien_ocean.wav ocean_matched.wav --match <the mod's old ambient/underwater/ocean.ogg> 0.2, then --source ocean_matched.wav
source.notes: 44.1 kHz stereo, 10.6 s. The old loop, credited to this recording, matched no part of it at any speed: rebuilt 2026-11-10 from it, slowed to 0.85x (pitch and time together, a bigger body of water than the underwater river, which is this recording as it is) and given the old loop's tone with --match.
